label: Button
description: Use Bootstrap button styles for reliable production actions: publish, review, and move work forward.

label: Button Group
description: Join related controls into one compact action surface.

label: Card
description: Display a structured surface with a header, body, and optional footer.

label: Typography
description: Align headings, labels, and body copy with Bootstrap's utility-first text semantics and Moo UI tokenized roles.

label: Kbd
description: Show keyboard shortcuts as readable command keys in concise operator and editor workflows.

label: Input
description: A native input primitive with Bootstrap form semantics for labeled, helper-aware, and validated fields.

label: Textarea
description: Use multiline input with Bootstrap-native textarea semantics for status notes, messages, and review context.

label: Input Group
description: Add icons, text, buttons, and helper content to inputs with Bootstrap's native grouping behavior.

label: Select
description: Choose one value from native option menus in admin forms.

label: Dropdown Menu
description: Collect contextual actions in one compact surface using Bootstrap's native dropdown behavior and placement.

label: Badge
description: Add compact labels, counts, and statuses with Bootstrap's native badge component.

label: Avatar
description: Represent people, teams, or accounts with a compact image or initials fallback.

label: Navigation
description: Create compact, semantic navigation surfaces with Bootstrap-native nav patterns for app shells.

label: Separator
description: Split admin workflows and list sections with Bootstrap-native separators.

label: Skeleton
description: Show loading structure with Bootstrap-native placeholders so lists, cards, and tables stay stable while data fetches.

label: Sidebar
description: Compose an application shell with Bootstrap-native sidebar primitives: provider, regions, menus, and inset content.

label: Close Button
description: Dismiss alerts, dialogs, and other transient content with Bootstrap's native .btn-close.

label: Alert
description: Surface a contextual message with Bootstrap's native alert region.

label: Breadcrumb
description: Indicate the current page's location within a hierarchy using Bootstrap's native breadcrumb list.

label: Pagination
description: Navigate paged results with native Bootstrap pagination controls.

label: Progress
description: Show the completion progress of a task using Bootstrap's native progress bar.

label: Slider
description: Select single values and ranges with native range input semantics, shadcn-like track/thumb styling, and optional value output.

label: Table
description: Display related rows and columns with Bootstrap's native, responsive table markup.

label: Checkbox
description: Toggle a single option using Bootstrap's native checkbox contract.

label: Radio Group
description: Let users choose one option from a related set using native Bootstrap radio controls.

label: Switch
description: Activate feature flags and settings with Bootstrap's native form-switch control.

label: Spinner
description: Show an indeterminate loading state using the same loader-circle icon as the reference, spun with Bootstrap's own animation.

label: Accordion
description: Reveal one section of content at a time using Bootstrap's Collapse plugin.

label: Tabs
description: Switch between compact operational views with Bootstrap's native tab behavior.

label: Collapsible
description: Reveal secondary details in place with documented Button markup and Bootstrap's Collapse behavior.

label: Tooltip
description: Show compact context hints for controls and actions on hover or keyboard focus with Bootstrap's native tooltip plugin.

label: Popover
description: Add compact, contextual details to workflow actions with Bootstrap's native popover behavior.

label: Dialog
description: A window overlaid on the page, built from Bootstrap's own Modal plugin and auto-initialized through its data attribute API.

label: Toast
description: Surface short operational updates that should stay visible long enough to be noticed.

label: Sheet
description: A side panel that slides from the viewport edge using Bootstrap's Offcanvas behavior.

label: Field
description: Compose the ready Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Radio Group, and Switch controls into accessible, label-first fields using Bootstrap-native validation and semantic grouping.

label: Form
description: Build complete Bootstrap forms from native form and fieldset markup, visible labels, descriptions, validation feedback, and documented Field components.

label: Combobox
description: Autocomplete input for selecting one or more items from a suggestion list.

label: Toggle Group
description: Group related toggle buttons using Bootstrap's native checkbox and radio button-check contract.

label: Alert Dialog
description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response, built on Dialog's static-backdrop option.

label: Menubar
description: A bordered toolbar row that groups several documented Bootstrap Dropdown Menu contracts.

label: Context Menu
description: A right-click menu built on Bootstrap's documented dropdown-menu surface, with Moo UI owning only the pointer/keyboard invocation Bootstrap does not provide.

label: Data Table
description: Review release work with a server-rendered table that adds search, facets, sorting, selection, bulk actions, column visibility, and pagination.

label: Chart
description: Render Bootstrap-token-themed charts with Chart.js-native area, line, bar, pie, doughnut, polar, radar, scatter, and bubble types.

label: Date Picker
description: Select single dates and ranges with a button trigger, popover, and keyboardable calendar.
